description: How the University Senate files a member of the campus community, by UMD Directory ID: their college, department, title, population and constituency. To find who represents them, call senate_list_senators with that constituency, and with the college too when represented_by_college is true, as the site's "Find My Senator" tool does. No login needed.

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID, the part of a umd.edu email before the @

name: senate_get_constituent

constituency.description: Constituency they vote in, e.g. "Tenured/Tenure-Track Faculty"

population.description: Population the Senate files them under, e.g. "Faculty"

represented_by_college.description: Whether their constituency elects senators per college, so their senators are those with both this constituency and this college; otherwise the constituency alone

title.description: Job title, or null for students

title: Get a constituent
